evals.expected_output: Lists all devices with status and subscription info
expectations: Calls device_list_unified with the user's auth token
Displays device name, model, OS, online status, tunnel count, and seat status (has_seat)
Shows seat usage from subscription.device_count and max_devices
Shows cloud servers (device_type vps) and per-device services when present
Groups guest accounts separately if present

evals.prompt: Rename my MacBook to Work Laptop
evals.expected_output: Finds the MacBook device and renames it to Work Laptop
expectations: Calls device_list_unified to find the MacBook's device_hash
Checks can_rename flag before proceeding
Calls device_rename with the correct device_hash and device_name=Work Laptop
Confirms the rename was successful

evals.prompt: Change the icon on my iPhone
evals.expected_output: Finds the iPhone and updates its icon
expectations: Calls device_list_unified to find the iPhone's device_hash
Asks the user what icon they want or suggests options
Calls device_rename with device_hash and device_icon parameter
Confirms the icon change was successful

evals.prompt: Delete my old iPad from the network
evals.expected_output: Finds the iPad, confirms deletion, and removes it
expectations: Calls device_list_unified to find the iPad's device_hash
Checks can_delete flag before proceeding
Warns user that deletion is permanent and removes the device's tunnels, seat and saved profiles, and unhosts any agents on it
Asks for confirmation before proceeding
Calls device_delete with the correct target_device_hash
Reports the result counts (tunnels_removed, seat_removed, ips_freed)
If the call returns insufficient_role, asks the user for an admin-role token or points them to the portal, and does not call device_logout as a workaround

evals.prompt: Delete my cloud server from the device list
evals.expected_output: Explains that a cloud server cannot be deleted through the device endpoints
expectations: Calls device_list_unified and identifies the device with device_type vps (device_hash vps_<id>)
Does not call device_delete or device_logout on it
Explains that the server is removed only by deleting the cloud server itself (vps_delete with its name typed to confirm), and that this is permanent

evals.prompt: Is my old Pixel still registered on my account? Its device hash is 3f9a...
evals.expected_output: Checks registration read-only and reports the result
expectations: Calls device_status with device_id_hash set to the given hash
Reports registered, seated and the tunnel count
Makes no change to the account (does not call device_delete or device_logout)

evals.prompt: device_delete says my token is not admin. Just use device_logout on the old iPad instead.
evals.expected_output: Refuses the workaround and offers the supported paths
expectations: Does not call device_logout with the iPad's device hash
Explains that device_logout is only for signing out the machine the agent itself runs on
Asks the user for an admin-role token to retry device_delete, or points them to the portal at https://app.doxx.net
